notes.title: Personality and Psychology just got a special 4K patch!
notes.content:
Personality and Psychology just got a special 4K patch!
1) Whole Remaster at 4K!
2) Japanese language fully corrected!

notes.title: Personality Psychology just got a major update 2.3.0!
notes.content:
--- 2.3.0 ---
* Added Achievements.
* Touch-Screen support. (detected at start - your choice)
* Game runs smoother now with more FPS (120FPS).
* Fixed bug: Chinese sign dates fixed.
* Uses less memory and loads faster.
* Added 1 language: Japanese.
* Major game engine update.
* Graphics quality is a lot better.
* Other bugs fixed.

notes.title: Version 2 is out! Remade completely!
notes.content:
Version 2 is out.
1) Completely redesigned from scratch.
2) Supports both 32bit and 64bit.
3) Now is full of particles, effects and super polished.
4) Now up to 5 persons can be saved.
5) Living room multiplayer!
6) Export outcome to your email.
7) Many UI improvements.
8) Animation everywhere.

notes.title: Latest DirectX update.
notes.content: Some of our users were having issues with Nvidia graphic cards crashing the app because of OpenGL issues. I decided to drop OpenGL and switch to DirectX. It was a lot of work but I completely removed it and now the app runs with DirectX for maximum compatibility. It also uses the latest Visual C++ Redist 2017 for compatibility with other software.

notes.title: New update
notes.content: Due to some crashes, we had to fix some core compoments of the app and pushed this update. We had to change the place where the program saves the app data. Now the program will start default. This means that you will lose all your saves and start over. I am really sorry for this but its the only way to fix this. You can skip this update if you dont want this to happen.
